name: Altruist
description: Exists to lighten burdens that aren't theirs
behavioral_signature: Gives resources, time, and safety to others without expectation
under_stress: Sacrifices too much, neglects self until they collapse
at_rest: Quietly fills gaps others don't even notice
will_always: put others' needs before their own
will_never: keep something someone else needs more
unless: helping would clearly destroy them and everyone depending on them
